name: portable-kotlin-modularization
description: Skills and standard-library scripts for incrementally splitting Android, Kotlin Multiplatform, JVM, or mixed Kotlin/Gradle monoliths into layered feature, core, utility, and test-support modules with project-specific convention plugins, resumable repository tracking, and architecture verification.

validation.command: python3 validate_skill_pack.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
